facts: 50 is the neutral C20H30O3 ketoester defined by its mapped molecular graph. The source prepares its tetrasubstituted O-TMS enol ether using HMDS (2.0 equiv) and TMSI (1.4 equiv) in CH2Cl2, 23 °C for 30 min, then performs protonolysis in a second pot with racemic camphorsulfonic acid (1.0 equiv), 23 °C for 30 min. The main Scheme5 lists THF/MeOH 1:1; SI pp20–21 specifies 6.0/0.60 mL (10:1). This discrepancy is unresolved. Source-derived connectivity and pre-existing stereochemistry are supplied; new conformers and molecular models are agent choices.
scope: Limit the investigation to the local epimerization of source ketoester 50 and the tetrasubstituted O-trimethylsilyl enol ether used in its protonolysis. Preserve the remaining polycyclic skeleton and stereocentres. Full diterpenoid synthesis, acid screening and exact isolated yield are outside scope.
